app_name.description: Name of your application. Used for state tracking and log messages.

service_type.description: Process manager type. Determines how services are restarted.

service_name.description:
Service name pattern. Use %i as placeholder for instance ID.
For systemd: maps to unit names like 'my-api@3000.service'
For pm2: maps to pm2 app names like 'my-api-3000'

instances.description: List of service instances to manage. Each instance gets its own port and env vars.

port.description: Port number this instance listens on.

deploy_path.description: Base path on the server where releases are stored. The daemon creates upload/, releases/, and current/ under this path.

build.description: Build steps executed sequentially on the dev machine. Each step runs via 'sh -c <step>'. Fails on first non-zero exit.

artifacts.description: Files and directories to upload to the server via rsync. Paths are relative to the project root.

exec_start.description: Custom systemd ExecStart command. Defaults to <deploy_path>/current/<first_artifact>. Set for interpreted apps (Node.js, Python, etc.): 'node app/server.js'

host.description: Server hostname or IP address. If a hostname that doesn't resolve via DNS, ~/.ssh/config is read for HostName.

api_port.description: Port the daemon API listens on (default: 8443).

api_key.description: API key for authenticating with the daemon. Optional — can be set via MINIDEPLOY_API_KEY env var or .env file instead.

env.description: Global environment variables passed to all instances. Merged with (and overridable by) instance-specific env.

keep_releases.description: Number of old releases to keep on disk (0 = keep all). Oldest releases are pruned after a successful deploy.

health_check.description: Health check configuration for zero-downtime verification. If configured, the daemon HTTP GETs each instance after restart and auto-rollbacks on failure.

endpoint.description: HTTP path to check on each instance (e.g. /health).

timeout.description: Seconds to wait per health check request.

retries.description: Number of retries per instance before marking failed.

wait_between_instances.description: Seconds to wait between checking each instance.

pre_deploy.description: Hooks run on the server AFTER the symlink swap but BEFORE the service restart. (Future feature — reserved.)

post_deploy.description: Hooks run on the server AFTER the service restart. (Future feature — reserved.)
